title: Footprint, Symbol and 3D model for this STM32F407ZGT6 Board
content:
Hello,

Does someone have footprint, symbol and 3D model for this STM32F407ZGT6 board?

Best regards and thanks in advance,

Toby

scraped_replies.html:
That’s not an ST board.

Use of “welding” suggests Chinese.

 

Try a google* image search to find the manufacturer or suppliers …

 

* Other internet search engines are available
